title: Disquisitiones Arithmeticae

definitions.statement: Section I, Art 1: Numbers whose difference is divisible by m are congruent.
Section II, Art 13: a is quadratic residue mod p if x^2 = a (mod p) has integer solution.
Section V, Art 153: F(x,y) = ax^2 + 2bxy + cy^2 of determinant D = b^2 - ac.

theorems.label: Theorema Fundamentale (Quadratic Reciprocity)
theorems.statement: Section IV, Art 131: For distinct odd primes p and q, (p/q)(q/p) = (-1)^((p-1)/2 * (q-1)/2).

theorems.label: Class Number Finiteness
theorems.statement: Section V, Art 172: The number of classes of binary quadratic forms of given determinant D is finite.

theorems.label: Cyclotomic Construction
theorems.statement: Section VII, Art 365: Regular polygon of n sides constructible with ruler and compass iff n = 2^k * p_1 * ... * p_r with Fermat primes.

conjectures.label: Gauss Class Number Problem
conjectures.statement: h(D) -> infinity as D -> -infinity, and complete determination of determinants with small class numbers.

open_gaps: Connection between quadratic form class numbers and analytic L-functions (later established by Dirichlet 1839).
Generalization to cubic and higher reciprocity laws.
computational_handles: Exact Legendre symbol (a/p) and Jacobi symbol evaluation via reciprocity.
Reduction algorithm for positive definite binary quadratic forms.
Finite class group cl(D) composition and structure verification.

citations.ref: Gauss, C.F. (1801). Disquisitiones Arithmeticae, Leipzig: Gerh. Fleischer.
